props.name: as
props.description: The element or component this component should render as. Can be overwritten by `asChild`.

props.name: asChild
props.description:
Render through the passed child element instead of the default one, merging
their props and behavior while keeping the primitive's.

props.name: defaultValue
props.description: The state of the switch when it is initially rendered. Use when you do not need to control its state.

props.name: disabled
props.description: When `true`, prevents the user from interacting with the switch.

props.name: falseValue
props.description: The value used when the switch is off. Defaults to `false`.

props.name: modelValue
props.description: The controlled state of the switch. Can be bind as `v-model`.

props.name: name
props.description: The name of the field. Submitted with its owning form as part of a name/value pair.

props.name: required
props.description: When `true`, indicates that the user must set the value before the owning form can be submitted.

props.name: trueValue
props.description: The value used when the switch is on. Defaults to `true`.

props.name: value
props.description: The value given as data when submitted with a `name`.
